blocking_findings.finding: Rust includes synchronous admission, Created-to-Start and queue time in relation/mutation command timeout; current C++ passes the full timeout to Session::execute and starts it at worker execution. A delayed created write may execute after the reference total deadline.

Rust Host rejects oversized canonical parent keys/arity/nodes/depth with DOMAIN_ERROR/code6 before projection lookup. Current adapter directly calls pure compile_relation, which rejects these as INVALID_ARGUMENT/code11 and allows projection evaluation to precede the Host capacity check.

checks.name: Core/Interop ABI and completion ownership
checks.basis: Compared Operation complete/take/reserve/try_retire/can_release with fixed native/interop/async/src/lib.rs. Callback invocation and moved-result destruction occur outside mutexes; source/callback leases remain charged until actual owner retirement. Subscription stop/retire has separate callback and source counts. write_abi/write_error preserve capacity/alignment/major checks and bounded records. EngineBoundary contains native exceptions and retains the existing poisoned/finite-quarantine distinction.

checks.name: Canonical runtime metadata, wire and codecs
checks.basis: Metadata is parsed and owned at runtime. Canonical re-encoding, SHA-256 identity, profile IDs, ordinal/codec/bound-ID/null checks, checked extent arithmetic and non-overlapping ranges guard db-wire/1. The seven-part scalar paths retain CLR integer/float/decimal/date/time limits, byte-preserving JSON handling and provider-specific rejection; 96-bit limbs avoid clang-cl-specific integer extensions. No compiled application table or DTO type is introduced.

checks.name: Physical provider execution and cancellation
checks.basis: SQLite prepares/binds without stepping until fetch; owned cells do not retain sqlite column pointers. Interrupt/close share lifetime mutex. PostgreSQL sends asynchronously, enables single-row mode immediately, and drains each PGresult through the final null result. Ordinary stop does not send a new cancel-key request; unsuccessful bounded drain physically closes instead of pooling. Typed OIDs, binary result widths, TLS validation, fixed thirteen Host environment refusals and the private libpq default patch match the documented reference boundary.

checks.name: Finite Source/Session/operation ownership
checks.basis: Pool leases remain charged through discarded physical close. Source admissions and the separate administrative permit queue are bounded and timed before taking provider workers. Dedicated administrative connections always close on success or exception. Operation callback failure poisons further Source admission while trusted cleanup is retained. Last pending decrement and join predicate share Source::mutex.

checks.name: Transactions, savepoints and unknown outcomes
checks.basis: Commit business outcome and cleanup disposition remain independent. Deadline publication retains the running driver, and late completion does not overwrite Unknown. PG 25P02 follows actual ROLLBACK and a known RolledBack outcome. Session physical return/close precedes last-parent transaction retirement. dispose_savepoint checks Closed/missing token before the Session gate, distinguishes actual non-top ordering from ordinary parent closure, and is shared by owner Drop and explicit close.

checks.name: Bounded cursor and batch retirement
checks.basis: One active fetch and one outstanding batch enforce backpressure. Fetch only steps enough rows for bounded wire bytes plus one bounded lookahead. The source reservation survives an independently owned batch. Cleanup worker drops its Cursor owner before publishing completion under the same mutex used by join; an unconfirmed cleanup retains its finite quarantine and is never called successful release.

checks.name: Migrations and catalog
checks.basis: SHA-384 SQLx checksums, _sqlx_migrations and _nativeweave_migration_phases persist unchanged. The bounded script guard, ordered versions, target/no-downgrade checks, explicit PostgreSQL nontransactional policy, advisory lock identity, SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE/rollback behavior and finite catalog budgets remain. Host closes the dedicated physical administrative connection on every completion path, preserving the already-existing checksum-lock mitigation.

checks.name: C++ producer, packaging and CI
checks.basis: Pinned Clang paths/hash/version/triple, C++20/C17, shared Ninja presets and isolated build trees replace Cargo. Source and dependency hashes bind the installed Release assets; package inventory audits exact exports, selected provider isolation and allowed dynamic closure and includes original dependency notices. The twelve package IDs/dependency graph and generated managed asset identity remain. Ordinary consumption does not compile C++. The no-Rust fresh builder and pinned pristine SDK consumer are separate gates. Leak-enabled sanitizer CI remains required; document/code review does not assert it passed.

checks.name: Relation/mutation Host admission and total deadline
checks.basis: Independent upstream final compiler/adjacent ABI review exposed two concrete Host adapter gaps; reread and confirmed against fixed Rust entrypoints. Dedicated actual ABI probe now authorized.

known_compatibility_corrections_in_curre.review: Re-read the final code, not merely the old delta. Predicate/publication use one mutex, and final worker owner release precedes the cursor completion ticket. Old failed candidate1 evidence remains failed.

Matches fixed coordinator.rs Closed/missing-token early return and preserves ordinary parent-close classification. The previously failing SQLite AOT continuation passed in the fresh candidate4 package comparison.

Matches SQL plus two complete wires, including the 96-byte zero-parameter envelope; per physical session rather than Source-wide. SQLite SQL-only describe and both-provider prepare precedence are restored. PG JSON+1/numeric24, SQLite storage widths and four-byte argument framing match fixed provider_size; Host codec errors map to code3 while physical capacity remains code6.

The fixed Rust BindingError conversion is code11, while Host borrow/owner/nullability checks retain their own earlier categories. Current package runs match the fixed actual 24-case ABI oracle with zero observed owners. Because I authored the conversion fix, separate non-author review is required for this subpart.
